</reasoning>

<reasoning>
The misaligned-address error is caused by the WMMA matrix-B shared-memory layout using a leading dimension of 17. WMMA requires an appropriately aligned base address and a valid leading dimension; the padded `[16][17]` layout does not satisfy that requirement for this half-precision WMMA path. Replace the shared-memory tiles with explicitly 32-byte-aligned arrays using a 16-element leading dimension, and update the WMMA B load accordingly. Also synchronize the stream after launch while debugging so execution errors are reported at the kernel call.
</reasoning>
